mapper.select: SELECT A.SN, A.MD_SJ, A.REVIV_CO, B.STRE_FILE_NM FROM MEDIA A JOIN FILE_DETAIL_INFO B USING(FILE_SN) WHERE SN = #{sn} AND A.UUID = #{uuid}

SELECT A.SN, A.UUID, A.MD_SJ, A.MD_CODE, A.REVIV_CO, A.FILE_SN, B.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, B.STRE_FILE_NM, B.FILE_EXTSN, B.FILE_SIZE, B.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM MEDIA A JOIN FILE_DETAIL_INFO B ON A.FILE_SN = B.FILE_SN WHERE A.USEYN = 'Y' AND A.UUID = #{uuid} ORDER BY A.SN DESC
